label.en: Displacement between chlorine, bromine and iodine

label.zh: 第三周期元素性质递变

label.en: Comparing a period and a group

cues.title: 新颜色从哪里来？
cues.titleEn: Where does the new colour come from?
cues.caption: 新颜色，是谁失去了电子？
cues.captionEn: Whose electrons produce the new colour?
cues.zh: 把氯水的原色留作参照。加入溴离子后出现了新的橙色，不能只用稀释来解释。跟住两个溴离子：它们各交出一个电子，成为一份溴；氯接受这两个电子，变成氯离子。小点记录电子收支，不是水中电子飞行的路线。新生成的溴，让第一条比较成立：在这些水溶液条件下，氯的氧化能力比溴强。
cues.en: Keep the original chlorine water as a reference. Adding bromide produces a new orange colour; dilution alone cannot explain it. Follow two bromide ions. Each gives up one electron, together forming bromine. Chlorine accepts the two electrons and becomes chloride. The dots record electron accounting, not free electrons flying through water. The product establishes our first comparison: under these aqueous conditions, chlorine is the stronger oxidant.

cues.title: 换成碘离子，还能交换吗？
cues.titleEn: Does the exchange work with iodide?
cues.caption: 换一种离子，追踪同一笔电子账。
cues.captionEn: A new ion; the same electron account.
cues.zh: 现在只把溴离子换成碘离子，仍保留氯水参照。棕色出现了。两个碘离子失去两个电子，氯接受它们。这笔净账把产物写成一份碘；含碘离子的水里还会有三碘离子，不能把颜色当成纯碘分子的计数器。第二条证据说明氯也能氧化碘离子，但单凭这两次比较，还排不出溴和碘谁更强。
cues.en: Now replace bromide with iodide, keeping the chlorine-water reference. Brown colour appears. Two iodide ions lose two electrons, which chlorine accepts. The net account records one iodine equivalent. In iodide-containing water, triiodide can also form, so colour is not a counter of pure iodine molecules. We now know that chlorine oxidizes iodide too. Those two comparisons alone still cannot order bromine and iodine.

cues.title: 补上缺的一条证据
cues.caption: 溴与碘的比较，让排序可以预测。
cues.captionEn: The missing comparison enables a prediction.
cues.zh: 用溴水试碘离子，棕色碘再次生成。这次接受电子的是溴，最后一条比较补齐了。把三条固定观察连起来，得到氯、溴、碘的氧化能力次序。现在反过来：用碘试溴离子，应该生成溴吗？先停一下。这个次序预测，在同类条件下不会发生明显的反向置换。保留的棕色是原来加入的碘，不是新生成的溴。规律的价值，在于能提出下一次可检验的预测。
cues.en: Test iodide with bromine water. Iodine forms again, but bromine now accepts the electrons. That supplies the missing comparison. Link the three fixed observations to order chlorine, bromine and iodine as oxidants. Reverse the last test: should iodine produce bromine from bromide? Pause before revealing it. The ordering predicts no appreciable reverse displacement under comparable conditions. Remaining brown colour belongs to the iodine added, not newly formed bromine. A useful pattern makes a testable new prediction.

cues.title: 没有明显气泡，就是不能反应？
cues.titleEn: Does no visible bubbling mean no reaction?
cues.caption: 镁的短时观察，不能代替速率与趋势。
cues.captionEn: A short observation cannot settle reactivity.
cues.zh: 进入第三周期的比较。回想钠遇冷水的明显反应，再看已经擦去旧氧化膜的镁条：同样的短观察时间里，变化很不明显。这不等于镁不能和水反应。放大表面，金属与水之间还有表面层和反应过程的限制；表面也会继续变化。没有气泡，是观察尺度上的结果，不是反应量永远为零。保持这份镁和水，升温以后会怎样？
cues.en: For the period-three comparison, recall sodium’s obvious reaction with cold water. Magnesium, cleaned of its old oxide coating, changes much less during a short observation. That does not mean it cannot react with water. At the surface, layers and reaction barriers constrain the process, and the surface keeps evolving. No obvious bubbles describe this observation window, not a reaction extent fixed at zero forever. Keep the magnesium and water: what should heating reveal?

cues.title: 气体里的氢原来在哪里？
cues.titleEn: Where was the hydrogen before it became gas?
cues.caption: 水里的氢变成气体，镁交出电子。
cues.captionEn: Water supplies the gas; magnesium supplies electrons.
cues.zh: 加热后，气泡和碱性变得明显。把净变化放大：镁交出两个电子，水中的两个氢接受这份还原当量，组成氢气。跟住原来的氧和剩下的氢，它们仍以氢氧根的组成留在氢氧化镁里。一个镁、两个水，对应一份氢气和一份固体。粉红色只提示碱性，不能数出生成了多少。升温改变这段观察中的快慢；元素比较还要结合下一组氢氧化物证据。
cues.en: Heating makes bubbles and alkalinity noticeable. Enlarge the net change. Magnesium supplies two electrons; two hydrogens from water accept the reducing equivalents and form hydrogen gas. Track the original oxygens and the remaining hydrogens: their hydroxide composition stays in magnesium hydroxide. One magnesium and two waters give one hydrogen molecule and one formula unit of solid. Pink colour indicates alkalinity, not product quantity. Heating changes the observed pace. Comparing elements also needs the hydroxide evidence that follows.

cues.title: 同样的白色，组成也相同吗？
cues.titleEn: Does the same white colour mean the same composition?
cues.caption: 氨从水接受质子，沉淀保存金属身份。
cues.captionEn: Ammonia accepts a proton; the metals retain their identities.
cues.zh: 分别给镁盐和铝盐加入氨水，两份白色沉淀看起来相像。氨怎样提供氢氧根？跟住水里的这个氢：质子转给氨，留下氢氧根，氨变成铵离子。净组成中，一个二价镁需要两个氢氧根；一个三价铝需要三个。金属没有换身份，也没有在这里得失电子。颜色相似，不能推出化学性质相同。接下来分别给两种沉淀加酸、加碱。
cues.en: Ammonia produces similar white precipitates from magnesium and aluminium salts. Where does the hydroxide come from? Follow a hydrogen in water. A proton transfers to ammonia, leaving hydroxide and forming ammonium. In the net composition, one magnesium two-plus requires two hydroxides; one aluminium three-plus requires three. The metals retain their identities without a redox change. Similar colour therefore cannot establish identical chemistry. Separate portions will now face acid and base.

cues.title: 酸为什么能让两份沉淀消失？
cues.titleEn: Why can acid dissolve both solids?
cues.caption: 氢氧根的氧留在新生成的水里。
cues.captionEn: The hydroxide oxygens remain in the new water.
cues.zh: 加足酸，两种白色沉淀都减少。酸消耗氢氧根，固相继续溶解补充；净账里，原来的氧接上新增的氢，成为水，金属进入水溶液。镁的一份需要两个质子，铝的一份需要三个。现在给各一份沉淀相同的两个净质子当量：镁可以溶完，铝还剩三分之一。这里比较的是扣除背景反应后的净量，不是教材的滴数。少加试剂留下固体，不能误判成它完全不与酸反应。
cues.en: With enough acid, both white precipitates diminish. Acid consumes hydroxide, and further solid dissolves to replenish it. In the net account, the original oxygens acquire added hydrogens to form water, while the metals enter solution. One magnesium formula unit needs two protons; aluminium needs three. Give each one unit of solid just two net proton equivalents. Magnesium can dissolve completely, but one third of the aluminium solid remains. These are amounts after background reactions, not textbook drop counts. Insufficient reagent is not evidence of no reaction.

cues.title: 碱为什么只带走其中一份？
cues.titleEn: Why does base carry away only one solid?
cues.caption: 铝的价态不变，配离子的总电荷变了。
cues.captionEn: Aluminium keeps its oxidation state; the complex has a new charge.
cues.zh: 换用新取的沉淀加足强碱，铝这一份溶解，镁这一份在教材条件下仍明显保留。跟住铝的净组成：加入一个氢氧根，得到能留在水里的四羟基合铝离子。铝仍是正三价，整个配离子却带一个负电荷。这是配位与溶解的联系，不是铝被还原。只给半份净氢氧根，铝沉淀能全消失吗？不能，净计量只够一半。把这些证据放回钠、镁、铝的位置：同为第三层，核电荷增大、原子半径减小；氢氧化物从强碱走向两性。周期性是多条受条件约束的证据共同支持的规律。
cues.en: Add enough strong base to fresh portions. Aluminium hydroxide dissolves; magnesium hydroxide remains conspicuous under the textbook conditions. Follow the aluminium composition. One extra hydroxide yields a soluble tetrahydroxoaluminate ion. Aluminium remains plus three, although the whole complex carries one negative charge. This links complex formation to dissolution, without reducing aluminium. Would half a net hydroxide equivalent dissolve the whole solid? No: the account permits only half. Return the evidence to sodium, magnesium and aluminium. With the same outer shell number, nuclear charge rises and atomic radius falls; hydroxides progress from strongly basic toward amphoteric behaviour. Several conditional comparisons support the periodic pattern.

question.zh: 三次变色，怎样排出氧化能力？
question.en: How can three colour changes order oxidizing ability?

lead.zh: 保留卤素水参照，跟住电子去向，再预测一次反向比较。
lead.en: Keep the halogen-water reference, follow electron transfer, then predict a reverse test.

principle.zh: 置换方向记录氧化剂接受电子的相对能力；独立观察先组成次序，次序再预测未试的组合。
principle.en: Displacement identifies relative electron-accepting ability. Fixed observations establish an ordering, which predicts an untested combination.

question.zh: 用碘水试溴离子，会生成明显的溴吗？
question.en: Should iodine water produce appreciable bromine from bromide?

explanation.zh: 在同类稀水溶液条件下，次序预测不会明显反向置换。棕色可来自原先的碘，须与参照比较。
explanation.en: Under comparable dilute aqueous conditions, the ordering predicts no appreciable reverse displacement. Brown colour may belong to the original iodine, so retain the reference.

question.zh: 两份白色沉淀，为什么遇碱分出不同？
question.en: Why do two white precipitates respond differently to base?

lead.zh: 先分清镁与水的观察快慢，再追踪酸碱比较里的氧、氢和金属。
lead.en: Separate reaction pace from identity, then track oxygen, hydrogen and metal through acid and base comparisons.

principle.zh: 酸消耗氢氧根促进两种固相溶解；强碱还可稳定铝的可溶羟基配离子。净组成和有限试剂量解释可见的剩余固体。
principle.en: Acid consumes hydroxide and promotes dissolution of both solids. Strong base can stabilize a soluble aluminium hydroxo complex. Net composition and finite reagent amounts explain remaining solid.

question.zh: 每份铝沉淀只给半个净OH⁻当量，能够全溶吗？
question.en: Can half a net hydroxide equivalent dissolve one unit of aluminium hydroxide?

explanation.zh: 不能。Al(OH)₃ + OH⁻ → [Al(OH)₄]⁻ 的净量只够一半；残留不等于完全不反应，也不是实际滴数预测。
explanation.en: No. The net equation Al(OH)₃ + OH⁻ → [Al(OH)₄]⁻ permits only half. Remaining solid does not mean no reaction and is not a prediction of laboratory drop counts.

question.zh: 怎样让比较实验给出可检验的规律？
question.en: How can comparisons produce a testable pattern?

lead.zh: 从点滴板颜色到沉淀去向，让每一条比较补上新的证据。
lead.en: From spot-plate colours to the fate of precipitates, make each comparison add evidence.

principle.zh: 对照、电子收支与酸碱配位净账把观察连成规律；反向卤素和不足量酸碱检验预测，不能仅凭快慢或颜色排序。
principle.en: Controls, electron accounting and acid-base complexation connect observations to a pattern. Reverse halogen tests and limited reagents test predictions; colour or speed alone cannot establish the order.

question.zh: 白色沉淀没有完全消失，就证明不发生反应吗？
question.en: Does remaining white solid prove there was no reaction?

explanation.zh: 不证明。先区分净试剂不足与反应方向：两个净H⁺当量可溶完一份Mg(OH)₂，却只溶去一份Al(OH)₃的三分之二。
explanation.en: No. Distinguish limited reagent from reaction direction: two net proton equivalents dissolve one unit of Mg(OH)₂, but only two thirds of one unit of Al(OH)₃.

scientificBoundaries: Qualitative textbook records are fixed and separate from model predictions. No concentration, equilibrium or colour calibration is inferred.
Mg cold observation means not obvious over a short window, not thermodynamic impossibility or a zero-rate law. Surface diagram is qualitative; no imported Mg/Fe/NaCl microscopic mechanism.
Halogen net electron credits are accounting symbols, not free aqueous particles. I2 equivalents omit I3−/hydrolysis; oxidant limited to stoichiometric amount.
Hydroxide net dose means after NH3/NH4+/other background acid-base consumption. Not laboratory volume or drop count. Trace solubility, hydration, activities and solid polymorphs omitted.
Solid composition boxes are formula-unit accounts, not isolated Mg(OH)2/Al(OH)3 molecules. Atom paths show net allocation, not elementary reaction mechanism.
The Na/Mg/Al row uses textbook radius values, not model-fitted observations; the selected comparisons support, but cannot alone prove, the complete periodic law.

chapters.caption: 铝的价态不变，配离子的总电荷变了。
chapters.captionEn: Aluminium keeps its oxidation state; the complex has a new charge.
